data: Which subcorpora have a Sarc. F-Measure above 0.65 when the Dataset size (in Posts/Class) is 400?

The question asks which subcorpora have a Sarc. F-Measure above 0.65 when the Dataset size is 400 posts/class. From the caption, we know that the x-axis represents the number of Posts/Class, and the y-axis represents the Sarc. F-Measure. The three subcorpora are Gen, RQ, and Hyp, represented by blue, orange, and gray lines respectively.

Looking at the graph, we can see that at approximately 400 posts/class on the x-axis, the Sarc. F-Measure for all three subcorpora is around 0.65 or slightly above. Specifically:

- For Gen (blue line), the Sarc. F-Measure is above 0.65.
- For RQ (orange line), the Sarc. F-Measure is also above 0.65.
- For Hyp (gray line), the Sarc. F-Measure is below 0.65.

Therefore, the subcorpora with a Sarc. F-Measure above 0.65 when the Dataset size is 400 posts/class are Gen and RQ.
